title: Hampi: As Large as Rome, Said a Visitor
description: Vijayanagara in the early 1500s: diamond markets, giant temples and a stone chariot.

scenes.narration: A Portuguese visitor said this city was as large as Rome, and very beautiful to see.
scenes.image_prompt: Portuguese traveller in 16th century clothing gazing at a vast Indian city among giant boulders

scenes.narration: It's the early 1500s. This is Vijayanagara, capital of a great South Indian empire. Today we call it Hampi.
scenes.image_prompt: aerial view of Vijayanagara city with temples, bazaars and boulder hills, Tungabhadra river
South Indian emperor Krishnadevaraya on a richly decorated throne, courtiers, 16th century

scenes.narration: Markets sell diamonds, rubies and pearls right in the open street.
scenes.image_prompt: busy bazaar street in Vijayanagara with traders selling gems and pearls, colonnaded stalls

scenes.narration: Temples like Virupaksha and Vittala rise among giant boulders along the Tungabhadra river.
scenes.image_prompt: tall temple gopuram among huge granite boulders by a river, pilgrims, festive day

scenes.narration: The famous stone chariot stands in the Vittala temple courtyard.
scenes.image_prompt: carved stone chariot in a temple courtyard with ornate pillared halls, golden sunlight

scenes.narration: In 1565, after a defeat at the Battle of Talikota, the city is sacked for months.
scenes.image_prompt: smoke rising over a ruined Indian city among boulders, 1565

scenes.narration: Its ruins still stretch for kilometres. Have you been to Hampi? Tell me below.
scenes.image_prompt: Hampi ruins at sunset from a hilltop, boulders and temples, tourists
